2026-10-30.title: A Soft Pause Between Busy Chapters
2026-10-30.lesson: Tomorrow, jot down one tiny moment, calm days deserve remembering too.
2026-10-30.note: Calm is enough today, Ruby, you don't have to earn rest.
2026-10-30.scene: A sleepy cat curled on a soft blanket by a rainy window, warm lamplight glowing.
